text:
maya: Heads-up  before we flip to GA I want a tightened acceptance checklist that separates pilot-only concessions from GA contract language. Need owners for: SLA text, docs polishing, support routing, monitoring alerts, and pricing runway. Who wants what?

eli: I'll handle SLA wording but we need a small matrix: model family x sequence-length x SLA applicability. Suggest columns: model_family, max_input_tokens, p50/p95/p99, credit_tier.

adrian: I'll own the matrix and will add a column for "fallback model" for capacity-based degradation.

noah: Support routing: billing issues -> billing-oncall (24h); policy exceptions -> product-onsite (3h ack); security incidents -> eng-security. I'll draft escalation map.

finance-bot: FYI we need explicit language for burst credits and how they expire. Legal wants a clause: "burst credits are promotional and may be rescinded with 30 days' notice."

legal-bot: Confirmed. Also recommend we avoid absolute uptime guarantees for non-dedicated/private deployments; use SLO-based credits only.

maya: Good. For monitoring owners: latency, errors, and token-cost-per-minute. Proposed thresholds:
- p99 latency: +20% vs baseline for 10m
- client-visible 4xx/5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m
- token-cost spike > 40% for 10m
Who picks these up?

eli: I'll wire latency alerts into the runtime dashboard and attach a runbook.
Runbook short steps:
1) validate the spike (windowed avg)
2) check model rollout history
3) rollback to previous model variant if correlated
4) scale pool or open ticket to eng-runtime

sophia: I'll finish the private deploy quickstart: steps, KMS snippet, audit-log sample, and a troubleshooting appendix that references Eli's runbook. Expect PR by Thu.

maya: Docs: we should add an explicit "What the SLA covers" banner listing: covered models, max token length, geographical exclusions. Also a short FAQ for customers about performance variability.

adrian: For product rollout: suggest we ship GA with 2 tiers: Hosted GA (with SLOs) and Dedicated GA (contractual SLA). Pilot customers get a reduced-billing pilot window (1M-token free burst) but not SLA credits.

noah: Can we add a metric to the billing dashboard: "cost-per-route-per-minute" so billing-oncall can immediately identify suspect routes? I'll add that and pair with an alert for sudden per-route spikes.

finance-bot: I'll prepare sample contract language for Dedicated SLA credits (tiered); include an example calculation with tokens/month and credit percentages.

maya: Acceptance checklist (draft):
- SLA matrix + legal-reviewed text (owner: eli/adrian/legal-bot)
- Docs PR with private quickstart & KMS examples (owner: sophia)
- Monitoring alerts + runbooks attached (owner: eli)
- Billing dashboard per-route cost metric + rota update (owner: noah/finance-bot)
- Pricing runway note + finance signoff on burst credits (owner: finance-bot)
- Oncall escalation map documented in ops playbook (owner: noah)

maya: Please reply with "ack" + any ETA. If all acked by EOD Fri we'll flip the Launch flag next week.

sophia: ack  PR Thurs am.

eli: ack  SLA text draft by Wed EOD.

noah: ack  rota update + dashboard by Fri noon.

adrian: ack  matrix and fallback plan by Thu.

finance-bot: ack  sample contract language by Thu, will loop in Legal.

legal-bot: ack  will review SLA text within 48h of Eli's draft.

deploy-bot: Reminder: final staging run at 2025-11-03T16:00Z. Smoke tests include latency SLO checks. :robot_face: 

maya: Thanks all. If anyone needs to reassign, call it out here now. Otherwise I'll begin updating the launch doc with owners and ETA. :rocket:
